name: Brief Dissociative Experiences Scale (Modified)
time_window_text: For each statement below, please indicate how much each thing has happened to you in the past SEVEN (7) DAYS.

items.text: I find myself staring into space and thinking of nothing.
People, objects, or the world around me seem strange or unreal.
I find that I did things that I do not remember doing.
When I am alone, I talk out loud to myself.
I feel as though I were looking at the world through a fog so that people and things seem far away or unclear.
I am able to ignore pain.
I act so differently from one situation to another that it is almost as if I were two different people.
I can do things very easily that would usually be hard for me.

band_descriptions.normal: Your responses suggest a normal range of dissociative experiences over the past 7 days. Most people experience occasional spacing out, and your responses fall within the typical range.
band_descriptions.mild: Your responses indicate mild dissociative experiences over the past 7 days. Most people experience this occasionally, but it is worth paying attention to.
band_descriptions.moderate: Your responses suggest moderate dissociative experiences over the past 7 days. Many people find it helpful to monitor this and explore grounding techniques.
band_descriptions.clinical: Your responses indicate a high level of dissociative experiences over the past 7 days. This level of detachment is significant, and speaking with a mental health professional is strongly recommended.
